solver.residual_guard: ||Av-(v^T Av)v||_2 <= 1e-8 max(1,abs(v^T Av)); vector normalized; finite scalars required.
solver.weight_guard: abs(sum(weights)-4)<=1e-11, signed weights retained without clipping, negative weight count/mass recorded.
solver.limits: Per-extreme6h wall, no silently accepted partial Ritz pair. Stop via matvec counter and wall guard; preserve unsuccessful row and current counters.

fit.model: lambda_extreme = intercept + slope*log(m/mref), unweighted float64 SVD, each design column scaled to unit2norm. mref smallest physical m per window. Rank2 required.
fit.scope: Fit minima and maxima separately, each m parity separately, exact disjoint4-point windows. No fit when any required row incomplete/failed.
fit.stability: For each sign and parity: both fitted slopes have predicted sign (minus<0,plus>0), abs(slope)>=1e-4, abs(slopeA-slopeB)/max(abs(slopeA),abs(slopeB))<=0.05, and each maxabs fit residual <= 0.01*abs(slope)*log(max(m)/min(m))+1e-7. Report raw/scaled condition numbers, all residuals and endpoint contrast.
fit.K4: Only for a sign whose BOTH parities satisfy stability, compare each finalB slope with preregistered heuristic model display (minus -0.1336 or plus 0.0456); relative discrepancy>0.10 operationally kills that model sign; no stable window => INCONCLUSIVE and no kill. Clearly mark comparison to uncertified finiteK128 heuristic; does not decide exact Bessel-model full norm.
fit.K5: S3 prediction is parity equality. No measured agreement statement unless both parity fits stable and finalB relative slope difference<=0.05 for the sign. A failed equality check is finite-window disagreement only.
fit.condition_guard: Scaled SVD design rank2; scaled condition2<=100 and finite coefficients/residuals; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE. Report unscaled condition2 also. No historical fit used to set this threshold.
